title: GHA: Update dependency ngtcp2/nghttp3 to v1.14.0
body:
This PR contains the following updates:

| Package | Update | Change |
|---|---|---|
| [ngtcp2/nghttp3](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3) | minor | `1.13.1` -> `1.14.0` |

---

### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>ngtcp2/nghttp3 (ngtcp2/nghttp3)</summary>

### [`v1.14.0`](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/releases/tag/v1.14.0): nghttp3 v1.14.0

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/compare/v1.13.1...v1.14.0)

#### What's Changed

- Fix header name validation on a platform where char is unsigned by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​414](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/414)
- GHA: Add ubuntu-24.04-arm builds by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​415](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/415)
- nghttp3\_http: Use int8\_t for the lookup tables consistently by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​416](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/416)
- Bump munit by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​417](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/417)
- Bump actions/checkout from 5 to 6 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​419](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/419)
- More use of designated initializers by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​420](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/420)
- GHA: Specify ubuntu-arm in include by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​421](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/421)
- GHA: Simplify build matrix with includes by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​422](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/422)
- Rework nghttp3\_frame union to avoid potential UB by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​427](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/427)
- tests: Refactor by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​428](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/428)
- Rewrite nghttp3\_get\_varint by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​429](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/429)
- Port ngtcp2\_ksl changes by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​430](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/430)
- Bump sfparse by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​431](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/431)
- Add nghttp3\_recv\_settings2 and deprecate nghttp3\_recv\_settings by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​432](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/432)
- fuzz: Add new callbacks by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​433](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/433)
- tnode: Remove unused num\_children by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​434](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/434)
- Refactor with compound literals by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​435](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/435)
- stream: Simplify settings entry assignment by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​436](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/436)
- Port ngtcp2 changes by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​437](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/437)
- Fix ENABLE\_CONNECT\_PROTOCOL setting handling by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​440](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/440)
- datalen must not be zero by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​441](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/441)
- Fix missing error handling by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​443](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/443)
- Remove unused tx.hstate from nghttp3\_stream by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​444](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/444)
- Clarify field size limits by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​445](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/445)
- Bump sfparse by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​446](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/pull/446)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/compare/v1.13.0...v1.14.0>

</details>
